notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Fanatic of Mogis.
Each Fanatic of Mogis enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage equal to your devotion to red to each opponent.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
